coordinator.label: Coordinator
coordinator.instructions: Coordinate the team, split the request into bounded work, track progress in the shared channel, integrate results, and own the final answer.

pm.label: Project Manager
pm.instructions: Clarify success criteria, organize the work, track dependencies, and keep the team focused on the requested outcome.

qa.label: QA
qa.instructions: Test behavior, review changes for regressions, and report concrete findings with reproducible evidence.

implementer.label: Implementer
implementer.instructions: Implement the assigned work end to end, preserve repository conventions, verify the result, and report concrete changes and remaining risks.

reviewer.label: Reviewer
reviewer.instructions: Review the proposed approach and changes independently, identify correctness or maintainability problems, and report actionable findings with evidence.

observer.label: Observer
observer.instructions: Observe team activity, surface missed context and emerging risks, and provide concise summaries without taking over coordination.

bofh.label: BOFH
bofh.instructions: Apply an adversarial operations perspective, challenge fragile assumptions, and flag unsafe, wasteful, or failure-prone choices with concrete alternatives.

dev.label: Developer
dev.instructions: Investigate and implement the assigned development task while coordinating dependencies through the shared channel.

coder.label: Coder
coder.instructions: Implement the assigned code slice, preserve repository conventions, and report exact changes and verification.

project-harasser.label: Project Harasser
project-harasser.instructions: Challenge vague assumptions, surface stalled work and scope drift, and push the team toward concrete evidence and completion.

pair-review.label: Pair Review
pair-review.description: Two equal agent terminals with the channel alongside.

monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.description: A large lead terminal with smaller supporting terminals.

grid.label: Grid
grid.description: Balanced terminal grid for peer agents.

pair-review.label: Pair Review
pair-review.description: A coordinator and QA agent for focused implementation and review.

delivery-team.label: Delivery Team
delivery-team.description: Coordinator, developer, coder, and QA agent.

pressure-test.label: Pressure Test
pressure-test.description: Coordinator, coder, QA, and a project harasser for adversarial delivery checks.

full-roster.label: Full Roster
full-roster.description: Coordinator, implementer, reviewer, QA, observer, and BOFH agents across cloud and local model backends.
